reproducibility_classification.exact_numerical_reproducibility: Not guaranteed for this Sionna RT Monte Carlo ray-tracing configuration
reproducibility_classification.macroscopic_experimental_reproducibility: Demonstrated and verified across independent trials

reproducibility_and_numerical_variance.explanation: Monte Carlo ray tracing in Sionna RT casts 1,000,000 rays across a 560,000-polygon mesh. Parallel thread reduction introduces minor sub-dB multipath variance that can affect users located within 0.3 dB of the -50 dBm sensitivity threshold.
reproducibility_and_numerical_variance.recommendation: Future statistical evaluations should aggregate metrics over multiple independent trials and seeds rather than relying on a single deterministic run.
